{"id":2036059492,"question_id":26,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month","timestamp":1781681184,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2036059492/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array","memory":"22.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int removeDuplicates(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int index{};\n        int elem;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(elem != nums[i])\n            {\n                nums[index++] = nums[i];\n                elem = nums[i];\n            }\n        }\n        return index;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"remove-duplicates-from-sorted-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2155}
